name: Griffith John Willett International Scholarship (Master of Global Development)
summary: 50% tuition scholarship for students from listed Asian countries starting Griffith's Master of Global Development in Trimester 1 2028.
key: The Scholarship covers 50% of postgraduate coursework tuition fees only for the duration of the program.
who: Citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand, from one of 16 listed Asian countries
Minimum GPA of 4.0 on a 7-point scale or equivalent
Offer for the Master of Global Development; full-time, commencing in Trimester 1
how: Apply for the Master of Global Development, then submit a scholarship application with academic records and a personal statement
catches: Page metadata names a different scholarship; confirm details with Griffith
